description: Use when the user wants a sourced shortlist of audit firms and/or AI tools. Stores the request for review (source=mcp). Consent must be true. Replies that a sourced shortlist of 3 comes within 48 hours. No buyer data goes to any firm.

consent.description: Must be true to accept this exact consent line (same as the website form): "Stored for review now; shared only with the firms you select once routing opens in January 2027." Rejects when false or missing. Stored consent uses that line plus any named firms.

description.description: What the buyer needs in free text

email.description: Buyer email (work or personal; personal is flagged, never blocked)

frameworks.description: Framework slugs, e.g. soc-2, fedramp, iso-27001

need_type.description: What the buyer needs: audit (audit or certification firm), tool (software or AI tool), or not_sure

name: request_shortlist
title: Request a sourced shortlist
